about: Scene templates for the website-design skill. Each entry says what the scene is, which businesses and motion plans it suits, its dials (settings that can also be set from the address bar, e.g. index.html?palette=moss&spin=0.3), what to replace for a client, and how it behaves without JavaScript, without WebGL and with reduced motion. All demo names, copy and pictures are invented stand-ins.

scenes.name: Scroll film
scenes.technique: A journey drawn frame by frame as the visitor scrolls, told in chapters with a chapter list, ending at the booking.
swap: Frames: a filmed or rendered journey exported as numbered WebP frames, landscape and portrait sets (tools/frames.sh); pass frameCount, src and portraitSrc to SequencePlayer
Chapter text and the departures cards
Poster SVG for the no-script view

fallbacks.noJs: Poster picture and every chapter as plain text
fallbacks.reducedMotion: No scrubbing: each chapter shows its own finished frame

scenes.name: Layered hero
scenes.technique: The wordmark sits inside the picture, between the background plate and a foreground cut-out; layers part with the pointer and the scroll.
bestFor: any brand with one strong photograph
swap: Layer 3: a transparent cut-out of the foreground (subject, trees, building)

scenes.name: Estate walkthrough
scenes.technique: Room by room: one wheel turn, swipe or arrow key glides one room, with a big caption per room in a changing corner, a listing card and room counter.

dials.name: glide
dials.means: How quickly the picture catches up with the room

dials.name: fade
dials.means: Where the crossfade to the next room starts

swap: Frames of one continuous walkthrough (landscape and portrait), or one still per room
Listing card and the viewing form

fallbacks.noJs: Warm poster and every room caption as text
fallbacks.reducedMotion: Each room is a still, no dolly or crossfade

scenes.name: World configurator
scenes.technique: A 3D product you can turn; choosing a finish recolours the product and the whole world around it; size, quantity, price and add to bag. Opens with a fogged pane the visitor wipes clear.
swap: The lathe profile, or a glTF model of the real product
Finishes: one CSS block per finish sets sky, ground, body and accent colours
Prices and sizes in the form

fallbacks.noJs: An SVG of the product that still recolours with the finish (CSS :has)
fallbacks.reducedMotion: No fog intro, no idle spin or bob, colours switch instantly

scenes.name: Horizon sea
scenes.technique: A live sea and sky drawn by one shader, with sun glitter, a wake that follows the pointer and clicks, and dusk that turns to night with stars as the visitor scrolls. Headline split to opposite edges.
bestFor: fintech or luxury heroes that want calm

dials.name: sun
dials.means: Sun height at the top of the page

dials.name: night
dials.means: How dark the page gets at the bottom

swap: Sky and water colours in the shader

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Pause motion button available; scroll still changes the time of day

scenes.name: Particle form
scenes.technique: Tens of thousands of points hold a shape, scatter along the pointer's path and drift back, then morph into the wordmark and a data wave as the visitor scrolls. Measurement grid, counting figures, a statement that changes letter by letter.
scenes.engine: three.js points with a custom shader
swap: Form A or C: sample points from a 3D model (positions of a glTF mesh) instead of the sphere or wave

fallbacks.reducedMotion: No scatter, no rotation; figures show final values; statement does not rotate

scenes.name: Point scan
scenes.technique: A city block drawn as lines and points on a light ground; a ruler preloader folds into the mark; the headline unscrambles; scrolling dives into the street while the city dissolves into points and a statement appears.
swap: Buildings: positions and heights of the client's real site, or points sampled from a scan

fallbacks.reducedMotion: No preloader, no scramble, camera follows scroll without easing

scenes.name: Material orb
scenes.technique: A rendered orb that shows an assistant's state (ready, listening, thinking, answering), driven by a working prompt composer with suggestions and Ctrl+Enter.
swap: The demo answer: stream the real model's reply into the reply line and keep the state on 'speaking' while tokens arrive

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Orb nearly still; answers appear at once

scenes.name: World dashboard
scenes.technique: A working product dashboard rises out of a live aurora sky and is cut off at the fold so the page invites the next scroll; the chart switches metric and range; the aurora leans with the pointer.

dials.name: tilt
dials.means: Starting tilt of the dashboard in degrees

swap: The dashboard: the client's real screen rebuilt in HTML (better than a screenshot: sharp, translatable, searchable)

fallbacks.noJs: Aurora gradient poster; dashboard flat and complete
fallbacks.reducedMotion: No rise or tilt, aurora still

scenes.name: Picture tunnel
scenes.technique: A one-screen hero: pictures travel toward the viewer along both walls of a corridor out of a pale haze; drag, sideways scroll or arrow keys steer; pictures fold and split colour at speed; pause button.
scenes.engine: three.js planes with a bending shader
swap: WORKS: { src, title, year } for the real pictures, loaded as textures

fallbacks.noJs: A still picture and the full list of work
fallbacks.reducedMotion: Starts paused; buttons and keys step one picture

scenes.name: Zoom constellation
scenes.technique: Rounded picture tiles float around one centred phrase; scrolling flies through them to the next phrase. Pure CSS 3D.

dials.name: depth
dials.means: Length of the flight in px

swap: Tiles: real photos as img with width, height and lazy loading

fallbacks.noJs: A calm grid of tiles with the phrases as headings

scenes.name: Card fan
scenes.technique: GSAP choreography with Lenis on the GSAP ticker: floating cards in the hero, a pinned section where cards rise, stack and fan out, a giant marquee that moves with the scroll, and a section whose curved top edge flattens as it arrives.

dials.name: spread
dials.means: Fan angle per card in degrees

swap: Cards: product name, origin, notes, price and colour

fallbacks.noJs: Cards in a row, static marquee
fallbacks.reducedMotion: No Lenis, no pin, cards in a row

scenes.name: Texture studio
scenes.technique: A tool: load a photo, choose characters, dither, halftone, two-ink print or dot grid, tune it, drag to compare with the original, export a PNG.
bestFor: making on-brand textured imagery for any client
swap: Nothing: use it as is to make images, or lift a treatment into a page as a canvas background

scenes.name: ASCII ambient app
scenes.technique: A kelp forest drawn live in characters behind an app home screen: fish dart from the pointer, kelp leans while the visitor types, a headline rotates word by word and holds while writing; remembered pause button; Ctrl+K palette with focus kept inside.
swap: The creature: anything drawable from characters (birds, rain, stars, a city)

scenes.name: World story
scenes.technique: One live 3D world and a camera that travels through four stations; the page settles on the nearest station when scrolling stops; stations change through an ordered-dither pixel dissolve; pills in the header jump between stations; a small readout of station, time and altitude.
swap: CAM: camera position and target for each station
The world: terrain function and the landmark (replace with a glTF model)

fallbacks.noJs: Dusk gradient poster, all stations as text
fallbacks.reducedMotion: No smooth scroll or settle, camera jumps to each station, no dissolve
